hook: Does your online presence match what you actually do for your community? Let's find out.
direction: Angle: gentle audit invitation. Ask the audience to honestly compare their digital footprint to their real-world reputation. CTA: DM or comment 'audit' and we'll take a look together. Keeps the ownership/craftsmanship tone — no pressure, just an honest question. Graphic: ig-native (casual, short, typed-in-app feel).

facebook.text:
Does your online presence match what you actually do for your community? Let's find out.

Here's an honest question worth sitting with: if someone found you online for the first time, would they get an accurate picture of who you are and what you actually do for the people around you?

Not a polished version. The real one.

We do informal audits like this all the time. No pitch, no pressure. Just a fresh set of eyes comparing what your digital footprint says to what your real-world reputation already is.

Comment 'audit' below or send us a DM and we'll take a look together.
